name: 28_double_slit_L5_3d
energy_note: Staggered-field proxy; includes PML and is not an exact discrete invariant or calibrated joules.
detector_note: Mean sum of squared staggered electric components; not calibrated Poynting flux or antenna gain.
notes: Uses caption dimensions. L=15 is not Fraunhofer for the full 30-cell aperture; report full-aperture Fresnel number. Periodic x represents an aperture array. Added z depth is 64 cells, dz=dx, with 12-cell z PML. The x-y geometry, grid spacing and time-step count are preserved. Each former slit is now a finite rectangular aperture 24 cells high. Illumination has a 16-cell Gaussian radius in z.
